meta.name: atomic-file-staging
meta.description: Place atomic-write staging files outside every tree another process enumerates by allowlist - a write-then-rename temp that is a sibling of its target inside an npm `files` walk, a fixture tree, or a Unity Assets folder gets packed or copied as a shipped file without a meta (live, mid-write, or as a crash leftover) and breaks the export or the build. Covers why the exporter stages under .artifacts/export-cache/, why fixture materialization stages under .artifacts/fixture-staging/, when leftovers need a prune and when they are inert, and the tree-equality test that pins the invariant. Use when adding or reviewing write-then-rename code, staging or temp files near a packaged or copied tree, fixing an npm-pack "shipped file without meta" violation, or writing a no-tmp-leak test.
